description: Distretto Po - Delimitazione Linea di costa 2018 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by adbpo.it. Following the meeting of the Permanent Institutional Conference on 23 May 2017, the District Basin Authority of the Po River has become operational, replacing the Po River Basin Authority to which the interregional basin basins of the Rhine, Fissero-Tartaro-Canalbianco, Conca-Marecchia and the regional Romagnoli basins are annexed. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "District Po — Delimitation Coast Line 2018" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include open data. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
